verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting assistant docs say video conferencing links are automatically added to every meeting, alongside a bookable embedded calendar and a Zoom integration for scheduling and joining calls. That covers the core of auto-attaching a conference link to each booking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Google Meet and Teams are supported link providers (the Meet/Teams mention concerns turning meetings into tasks), any native video option, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
